title: Record Animated and International Entries Lead 99th Oscars Eligibility Lists
excerpt:
The Academy has unveiled the eligible films in three major categories.
There are 38 animated features, 104 international films and 190 documentaries.
body_md:
The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences has released its eligibility lists for Animated Feature Film, International Feature Film and Documentary Feature Film at the 99th Academy Awards. Record numbers in animation and international cinema highlight the breadth of this year's field before voting narrows the contenders to shortlists and eventual nominees.

A record 38 animated features are eligible for consideration. The selection includes major studio releases such as Toy Story 5, The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, Minions & Monsters, Hoppers, Coyote vs. Acme, The Cat in the Hat and Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender, alongside independent productions and international animated films. The range of filmmaking styles and distribution models makes the preliminary field unusually broad.

Eligibility is not the same as nomination. Some listed films must still complete their qualifying theatrical runs and satisfy all applicable rules. Members of the Academy's Animation Branch are eligible to vote, while members of other branches may opt in if they meet viewing requirements. Animated films can also qualify for other Academy categories, including Best Picture, where the relevant requirements are satisfied.

The Documentary Feature Film category has 190 eligible titles. Certain films that have won qualifying festival awards or have been submitted for International Feature consideration may also be eligible as documentaries. Members of the Documentary Branch determine the shortlist and nominations. The size of the field underscores the challenge facing filmmakers seeking visibility during the first stage of awards voting.

The International Feature Film category has reached a record 104 entries. One hundred came through country or regional submissions and four qualified through the festival-award pathway. Under Academy rules, eligible international features must be produced outside the United States and contain predominantly non-English dialogue. Iran's Land of Angels appears among the listed entries. Inclusion in the eligibility list, however, does not guarantee a place on the shortlist or a nomination.

Preliminary voting for selected categories is scheduled for December 7–11, 2026. Shortlists are due December 15, nominations will be announced January 21, 2027, and the 99th Academy Awards ceremony is scheduled for March 14, 2027. The announcement establishes the size of the competition, not the identities of the eventual nominees or winners.
